test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In which type of farming the land is used for growing food and fodder crops and rearing livestock?
solution:
The correct answer is** __Mixed farming.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mixed farming:-**

 
 
• It is a type of agriculture that combines the production of crops and livestock on the same farm.
 
• **The type of farming in which the land is used for growing food and fodder crops and rearing livestock is called mixed farming. (Hence option 2 is correct)**
 
• It is a sustainable and efficient system that can provide a variety of benefits, including:
 
 
• **Increased income and productivity**: Mixed farms can generate income from both crop and livestock sales, and the two enterprises can often complement each other. For example, the manure produced by livestock can be used to fertilize crops, and the crops can provide feed for the livestock.
 
• **Improved soil health: **Mixed farming can help to improve soil health by rotating crops and using manure to fertilize the land. This can lead to increased crop yields and reduced erosion.
 
• **Reduced risk**: Mixed farming can help to reduce risk by diversifying the farm's income streams. If one enterprise fails, the other can help to support the farm.
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Plantation agriculture:-**

 
 
• **Plantation agriculture is a type of commercial farming in which a single crop is grown on a large scale. **
 
• Plantations are typically owned by a single company or government, and they employ labourers to work on the land.
 
 
 
• **Subsistence farming:-**
 
 
• **It is a type of agriculture in which farmers grow crops and raise livestock to meet their own needs and the needs of their families, with little or no surplus for sale. **
 
• Subsistence farming is practiced all over the world, but it is particularly common in developing countries.
 
 
 
• **Shifting cultivation:-**
 
 
• **It is a type of agriculture in which plots of land are cultivated temporarily, then abandoned while post-disturbance fallow vegetation is allowed to freely grow while the cultivator moves on to another plot. **
 
• The period of cultivation is usually terminated when the soil shows signs of exhaustion or, more commonly, when the field is overrun by weeds.
 
• The period of time during which the field is cultivated is usually shorter than the period over which the land is allowed to regenerate by lying fallow.
